question: What is GLA University?
answer: GLA University is a private university in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral and diploma programs in Engineering, Management, Law, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Sciences, Commerce, Education, Agriculture and Arts.

question: Where is GLA University located?
answer: 17 km Stone, NH-19, Mathura-Delhi Road, P.O. Chaumuhan, Mathura-281406 (U.P.), India. It is on the Mathura-Delhi highway.

question: Does GLA have more than one campus?
answer: Yes. GLA has a Mathura campus (the main campus), a Greater Noida campus (noida.gla.ac.in), and GLA Online (glaonline.com). This FAQ set is mainly about the Mathura campus.

question: Is GLA University UGC recognised?
answer: Yes. GLA University is established under a UGC-recognised framework, registered under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956, and is a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).

question: What is GLA's NAAC grade?
answer: GLA University is accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade, as shown on the university website.

question: What are GLA's NIRF rankings?
answer: In NIRF 2025, GLA is listed in the Top 150 universities and Top 200 engineering institutes in India, in the Top 125 for Management, and ranked 48th under the Pharmacy category. Rankings change every year, so check the Awards & Rankings page for the latest.

question: How big is GLA in terms of students, faculty and alumni?
answer: According to the website: 26,000+ students enrolled, 850+ faculty members, and 50,000+ alumni settled across the globe.

question: Which institutes/schools are part of GLA University?
answer: Institute of Engineering & Technology, Institute of Business Management, Institute of Legal Studies and Research, Institute of Pharmaceutical Research, Institute of Applied Sciences & Humanities, Faculty of Education, and University Polytechnic.

question: What are students of GLA called?
answer: GLA students and alumni are affectionately called 'GLAdiators'.

question: How do I apply to GLA University?
answer: Apply online through the 'Apply Now' page on gla.ac.in (student.glauniversity.in admission portal), or contact the admissions helpline for offline help. Online and offline modes are both available.

question: What is the admission helpline number and email?
answer: Admissions helpline: +91-9027068068. Admissions email: admissions@gla.ac.in. General university email: glauniversity@gla.ac.in.

question: Is there an entrance exam for admission?
answer: GLA conducts its own entrance test, GLAET (syllabus and sample paper are on the Admissions section of the website). Admission to the general quota is based on rank in the entrance exam. Always confirm the current cycle's rules on the Admission Process page.

question: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech?
answer: Eligibility depends on the program and the year. See the Eligibility Criteria page under Admissions for exact marks and subject requirements (typically 10+2 with Physics and Maths). For international applicants the minimum is 50% in the qualifying exam with the pre-requisite subjects.

question: Is there any management quota or capitation fee?
answer: According to the university's FAQ page, there is no management quota and no capitation fee. The two quotas are General (based on the GLA entrance exam rank) and Foreign/NRI (based on 10+2 marks).

question: Is lateral entry available?
answer: Yes. Lateral entry programs are offered for B.Tech in Mechanical, ECE, ECE with Minor in CS, Electronics & Computer, Biotechnology, EEE, Electrical, Electrical with EV Technology and Civil Engineering, and for Bachelor of Pharmacy.

question: Where can I download the prospectus and admission forms?
answer: The Admissions menu on gla.ac.in has 'Download Prospectus' (admission booklet PDF) and 'Download Forms'.

question: Can international students apply?
answer: Yes. GLA has a dedicated International Admissions section covering fees, scholarships and how to apply. International applicants need at least 50% in the qualifying exam. Fees can be paid in US dollars or equivalent Indian rupees.

question: When should I apply?
answer: Apply as early as possible because seats are limited. The B.Tech 2026 application had a last date of 31-Mar-2026 on the website. Check the Admission Process page for the current cycle's dates.

question: Where are the counselling offices?
answer: See the 'Counselling Offices' page under Admissions on gla.ac.in for the list of counselling office locations and contacts.

question: How many programs does GLA offer?
answer: More than 84 programs across Graduate, Post Graduate, Doctoral and Diploma levels.

question: Which B.Tech branches are available?
answer: B.Tech CSE, CSE-AIML (in partnership with Microsoft), CSE Hons. (in collaboration with Intel NEC), ECE (including VLSI specialisation and Minor in CS), Electronics & Computer Engineering, Electrical (with Minor in CS or EV Technology specialisation), EEE, Civil, Mechanical (including Automobile specialisation and Minor in CS), Mechatronics and Biotechnology.

question: What non-engineering UG programs are offered?
answer: BCA (including Data Science, AIML, Digital Marketing), BBA (including Family Business, Data Analytics, Management Science), BA LLB, BBA LLB, B.Com (including Global Accounting with CIMA), B.Pharm, B.Sc. in Agriculture, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, BA English, BA Economics, B.Ed and B.Sc B.Ed (ITEP).

question: Which postgraduate programs are available?
answer: M.Tech (Design, Production, ECE, Electrical, Energy Systems, Structural, CSE, Transport), MBA (General, Honours, Business Analytics, Financial Markets & Banking, Logistics & Supply Chain), MCA and MCA-AIML, M.Sc. (Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Microbiology & Immunology, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Agriculture), LLM (Banking Finance & Insurance Law, Cyber Law & Data Privacy Law), MA English, M.Pharm.

question: Does GLA offer PhD programs?
answer: Yes. PhD is offered in English, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Microbiology & Immunology, Physics, Education, Mechanical, Mathematics, Economics, ECE, Chemistry, Electrical, Management, Computer Applications, CSE, Law, Agriculture & Horticulture and Civil Engineering. Doctor of Pharmacy is also offered.

question: Are diploma programs available?
answer: Yes, through University Polytechnic: Diploma in Mechanical, Pharmacy, Electronics & Communication, Chemical, Electrical, Civil and Computer Science Engineering.

question: What is the duration of the programs?
answer: Diploma programs start from about 12 months, and full-time degree programs run 4 to 5 years depending on the program. See each program page for exact duration.

question: What is the medium of instruction?
answer: The medium of instruction at GLA University is English for all programs.

question: What does the B.Tech CSE AIML program with Microsoft mean?
answer: It is a B.Tech CSE specialisation in AI and ML offered in partnership with Microsoft. See the program page on gla.ac.in for curriculum and what the partnership covers.

question: Where can I find the fee structure?
answer: On the Admissions > Fee Structure page of gla.ac.in. Fees vary by program and year, so check the official page for the current figures.

question: What fees apply besides tuition fee?
answer: Apart from tuition and registration fee, there is a security deposit, plus hostel accommodation and mess charges if you opt for hostel.

question: Does GLA offer scholarships?
answer: Yes, merit-based scholarships are offered. Continuing a scholarship depends on regular attendance, academic progress, and good conduct. Details are on the Scholarship Programs page.

question: How do I pay fees online?
answer: Use the 'Pay Online' link on gla.ac.in, which goes to the student portal at student.glauniversity.in.

question: Is there a fee refund policy?
answer: Yes. The Fee Refund Policy page under Admissions explains eligibility and timelines for refunds on withdrawal.

question: Does GLA have hostels?
answer: Yes. Hostel and mess facilities are available for students. Fee schedule and rules are on the Hostel and Mess page under Admissions.

question: Is hostel mandatory for first-year students?
answer: Check the current Hostel and Mess page or ask the admissions helpline, since hostel rules can change between sessions.

question: What facilities are available on campus?
answer: Academic facilities, labs, a library, sports facilities, innovation facilities, research facilities and centres of excellence, including the Capgemini CodeXperience Center. See the Facilities menu on the website.

question: Is there a virtual campus tour?
answer: Yes. A virtual tour is available at gla.ac.in under Campus Life > Virtual Tour.

question: How do I reach GLA University by road?
answer: The campus is at the 17 km stone on NH-19 (Mathura-Delhi Road), near Chaumuhan, on the highway between Mathura and Delhi. Mathura Junction is the nearest major railway station.

question: Does GLA have an anti-ragging policy?
answer: Yes. GLA has an Anti-Ragging page and an Anti-Ragging policy. Complaints can be raised through the committee listed on the website.

question: Is there a committee for women's safety and grievances?
answer: Yes. GLA has an Internal Committee (IC) listed on its website, along with other authorities and committees under About Us.

question: What is GLA's placement record?
answer: The website reports 86% overall placement over the past 5 years and 3,200+ job offers for the 2025-26 batch.

question: What are the highest and average packages?
answer: As listed on the website: highest package 60 LPA and average CTC 8.1 LPA. These are headline figures and vary by branch and year.

question: Which companies recruit from GLA?
answer: The placement network includes Microsoft, Amazon, Facebook (Meta), Cognizant, TCS, Infosys, Palo Alto Networks, Juspay, Capgemini, Cisco and others. See the Our Recruiters page.

question: When do internships start?
answer: The website says internship opportunities are offered to students from their second year based on interests, skills and talent.

question: How can I contact the placement team?
answer: Use the Placements > Placement Team and Helpline and FAQ's pages on gla.ac.in.

question: Is there an alumni network?
answer: Yes. The Placements > Alumni section has alumni testimonials, alumni jobs, alumni working abroad and a Get In Touch page.

question: Where can I find the academic calendar?
answer: On the Academics > Academic Calendar page of gla.ac.in.

question: Where can I find the syllabus?
answer: On the Academics > Syllabus page of gla.ac.in, organised by program.

question: How do I check my exam results?
answer: Use the 'Result' link in the footer of gla.ac.in, or log in to the student portal.

question: How do I log in to the student portal?
answer: Use the 'Student Login' link on gla.ac.in (student.glauniversity.in). Faculty and staff use the Employee Login.

question: Does GLA follow Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) and NAD?
answer: The website links to the Academic Bank of Credits (abc.gov.in) and National Academic Depository (nad.gov.in) for students.

question: Is there a minimum attendance requirement?
answer: Yes, regular attendance is expected, and it also affects scholarship continuation. The exact percentage is in the Academic Ordinance PDF on the website.

question: Does the library have digital resources?
answer: See the Academics > Library page for the collection, timings and digital resources.

question: What are the major annual events at GLA?
answer: Spandan (annual cultural fest), Techनव्या (technical innovation fest with robotics, coding and more), Prarambh (freshers' welcome), DJ x Dandiya Night, Founder's Day, and Convocation.

question: What clubs and societies are there?
answer: Examples listed on the website: MediaScoop Club (campus media), Ninad Club (music), Saturangle Club (debate) and Prakriti Club (nature and environment). Full list is under Campus Life > Clubs & Societies.

question: Are there sports facilities?
answer: Yes. The university encourages sports and adventure activities, with events organised through the year. GLA teams have won national-level medals, such as in basketball and powerlifting.

question: Do GLA students participate in hackathons and coding contests?
answer: Yes. The website highlights winners at Smart India Hackathon 2025 and Hack with Uttar Pradesh, and the footer links to ICPC West Asia. Student coding clubs also operate on campus.

question: Do industry experts and guest lecturers visit GLA?
answer: Yes. GLA has visiting faculty and professors of practice from industry, plus a Guest Lecture section on the website.

question: How strong is research at GLA?
answer: The website reports 850+ patents published, 14 research centres and 13,000+ publications in SCI and Scopus.

question: Does GLA support student startups?
answer: Yes. GLA has an Incubation Center, Technology Business Incubator (TBI), CSED (Center for Skill & Entrepreneurship Development), E-Cell, Innovation & Incubation Centre (IIC), NewGen IEDC and GENIE. See Entrepreneurship & Innovation on the website.

question: Are there industry partnerships?
answer: Yes. Partners include Capgemini, NASSCOM, GlobalLogic, Wipro and several international universities. See Placements > Industry-Academia Partnership and the MoU page.

question: Are there international collaborations or exchange programs?
answer: The website mentions collaborations with international universities enabling student exchanges, joint research and global exposure.

question: What are GLA University's contact numbers?
Where can I follow GLA on social media?
answer: GLA is on LinkedIn (GLA University), Instagram (@glauniv), Facebook (glauniv), X (@gla_mathura) and YouTube.

question: Where can I find mandatory disclosures, IQAC and NIRF documents?
answer: In the footer of gla.ac.in: Mandatory Disclosure, IQAC and NIRF pages.
